description: This file defines the PHP class `Subscription` in the `Opencart\Admin\Controller\Mail` namespace. The class extends a framework controller and contains methods related to handling subscription history, transactions, and email notification logic in the OpenCart admin area.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription emails, histories, and transactions within the OpenCart admin interface, including email notifications for subscription status changes and history logs.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Handles the display and processing of subscription history entries, including retrieving associated customer and store information, and sending notification emails about subscription updates.

methods.name: transaction
methods.description: Manages subscription transactions, including updating order details, notification emails, and logging transaction data related to subscription activities.
